# Election update: Saturday, November 28 (morning)

## Bottom line
No race was called overnight. The House stands at 432 of 435 races called: D 259, R 173, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Three races remain: MN-01, in a hand recount, and the Louisiana runoffs on Dec. 12. Every Senate race is called: D 56, R 44, counting seats not up ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Governorships are final at D 30, R 20 of 50, counting the 14 states with no race this year, with six flips, all to Democrats ([governor table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_gubernatorial_elections)).

## Called since the last update
- None.

## Still uncalled
- **HOU-MN-01** (Lean R): the state certified Jake Johnson (D) ahead of Rep. Brad Finstad (R) by 324 votes; Finstad requested a hand recount, and AP has not called the race. No new reporting on it today ([MPR News](https://www.mprnews.org/story/2026/11/19/brad-finstad-requests-recount-in-1st-congressional-district-after-loss-to-jake-johnson)).
- **HOU-LA-05** (unrated): runoff Dec. 12 between two state representatives, Pat Moore (D) and Gabe Firment (R), for the seat Julia Letlow is leaving, NOLA.com reports ([NOLA.com](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **HOU-LA-06** (unrated): runoff Dec. 12 between Chauna Banks (D) and Blake Miguez (R) ([WAFB](https://www.wafb.com/2026/11/04/chauna-banks-blake-miguez-advance-runoff-louisianas-6th-congressional-district/)).

- **Alaska:** the state report is unchanged since Nov. 23, 10:54 a.m. Alaska time, with Peltola at 50.14% of first-choice votes ([state report](https://www.elections.alaska.gov/enr/26GENR/results/ElectionSummaryReportRPT.pdf)).

## Legal and federal action
- **White House:** President Trump said he is prepared to use "tremendous power" if Democrats control Congress, ABC7 reports ([ABC7](https://news.google.?oc=5)).
- **Pennsylvania:** Stenstrom v. Schmidt, a voting-rights suit filed Nov. 23 in federal court in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, had its summons returned served on Nov. 27 ([CourtListener](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/75167735/stenstrom-v-schmidt/)). The tracker has not read the complaint.
- **Louisiana:** plaintiffs filed an amended complaint on Nov. 27 in Singleton v. Jefferson Parish Board of Election Supervisors, in federal court in the Eastern District of Louisiana ([CourtListener](https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/73424411/35/singleton-v-jefferson-parish-board-of-election-supervisors/)). CourtListener shows filings in 21 election-related federal dockets since Nov. 25.
